acceptance.meaning: FULLY_CERTIFIED_SCOPED applies ONLY to the explicitly recorded provider+input/behavior profiles, not all architectures or all advertised functions.

newly_certified.name: inspect_analysis_settings
newly_certified.scope: Runtime read-only settings inventory + exact setting/operation/provider filter; no mutations.
positive: jadx.operation_timeout_ms=120000ms returned as single exact filter and inspect_android_package operation
unknown provider returned zero settings, revision remained 0
negative: Invalid setting enum refused at client input-contract boundary
evidence: Live tool results; settings do not emit a retained Evidence ID
newly_certified.oracle: Filter membership, default count 11 and immutable revision 0 matched across reads.
limitations: Active values observed as not_observed; update_analysis_settings not executed.

newly_certified.name: inspect_byte_entropy
newly_certified.scope: Linux regular ELF64 /usr/bin/true whole-file and 4096/256-byte block-window entropy, no encryption inference.
negative: Nonexistent pathname rejected as invalid_input/path not found
newly_certified.oracle: SHA256 independently matched /usr/bin/sha256sum in earlier live controlled process; block counts match exact integer window division.
limitations: Entropy is not proof of encryption or compression.
Other file types and thresholds not comprehensively certified.

newly_certified.name: inspect_elf_notes
newly_certified.scope: Linux x86_64 ELF64 PT_NOTE and SHT_NOTE, including GNU property/build-id/ABI declarations.
newly_certified.oracle: Independent readelf -n of /usr/bin/true matched GNU build-id and ABI 3.2.0; hashes matched known baseline.
limitations: No ELF32 / other note owner or exotic malformed-note claim.

newly_certified.name: inspect_apk_signature
newly_certified.scope: Declared v1/v2 signing block structure, certificate SHA256 and signer consistency for existing Linux-local PINK debug APKs; NOT signature verification.
positive: installed-app.apk and pink-debug.apk contain v1 and v2 declarations, same signer certificate digest 21127c8e4f56b2130c5699588bfd1e882624eff442cad1ac3d1c09cf490121cb
Neither debug APK declares v3/v3.1, correctly reported absent
newly_certified.oracle: JADX inspect_android_package independently identified a real PINK APK and matched the selected pink-debug.apk SHA256=4eaf53478d7101341eae254c553424979f6b83464fd59873ecdfa50f235e11ce.
limitations: The tool does not cryptographically verify signatures.
v3/v3.1, rotation lineage and source stamp positive cases untested.
Fixture is older test APK, not owner's installed 46 MB release.

newly_certified.name: inspect_native_exports
newly_certified.scope: ELF64 AMD64 defined dynamic exports and PE32 absent-export-directory detection; static declaration only.
negative: /etc/hostname refused as unsupported_target; libz.so.1 symlink refused, correct regular-file-only admission
newly_certified.oracle: Independent pwntools inspect_binary_layout recognized same 113000-byte ELF amd64, 124 symbols and exact SHA; semantic export marker zlibVersion present.
limitations: PE with nonempty export directory, symbol forwarding and IFUNC behavior remain untested.

newly_certified.name: inspect_pe_imports
newly_certified.scope: PE32/PE32+ x86/x64 import-directory parsing with names and thunk RVAs on existing Windows binaries, no binding/execution.
negative: /usr/bin/true refused as unsupported_target, rather than producing PE import rows
newly_certified.oracle: Independent GNU objdump correctly classified samples pei-i386 and pei-x86-64; 32-bit import-directory file offset 8220 is within objdump .rdata file range starting 0x1a00 length 0xdd6; hashes unchanged.
limitations: Delay-loaded imports and ordinal-only positive samples not certified.

newly_certified.name: inspect_pe_load_config
newly_certified.scope: PE32/PE32+ load-config and absent TLS table on existing x86/x64 Windows binaries; static claims only.
positive: setuptools/gui.exe PE32 SafeSEH and security cookie, GuardFlags=256
setuptools/gui-64.exe PE32+ security cookie and CFG declarations; no SafeSEH interpretation for PE32+
newly_certified.oracle: Independent objdump -h section ranges contain reported 32-bit load-config offset 7184 (.rdata) and security cookie offset 10244 (.data); PE32/PE32+ independently classified.
limitations: No positive TLS callbacks or actual CFG enforcement verification.

newly_certified.name: inspect_python_pyc
newly_certified.scope: CPython 3.12 pyc header and marshal object inventory, without execution/decompilation.
positive: jsonref.cpython-312.pyc 21237 bytes, magic 3531, 39 code objects, 996 marshal objects, complete within view
newly_certified.oracle: Independent inspect_byte_entropy read exact same source sha256 790b18ddc4e1086596ee936417eeea7131b9df94c184082c86af94b4e963125e.
limitations: Other CPython versions and malformed nested marshal bodies not certified.
No recovery of source code performed.
